scope: Bounded read-only contract audit against the frozen initial 10-batch snapshot; no model call, no live task mutation, no semantic repair.
verification_level: contract/code inspection tied to existing real-replay evidence; not another E2E run

initial_blockers.message: Ordered part text must equal the source substring at the next exact offset.

contract_conclusion: For this exact-text-only feedback, role/field responsibility must stay unchanged. Changing cleanup to fill_slot or adding abstract.en changes the signature and is rejected. Text/whitespace edits may split/merge adjacent parts only while preserving the ordered deduplicated (role, field_id) signature.

lock_evidence.claim: Affected entries without any other blocker code become responsibility-locked.
Revision prompt explicitly requires preserving prior role/field responsibility.
Candidate compares revised and previous responsibility signature for locked entries.
Signature is ordered role/field pairs, merging adjacent identical pairs.

downstream_limit.conclusion: No checked downstream gate guarantees detecting that abstract.en should have been selected when the Agent instead classified the value text as cleanup. Mechanical closure/materialization/publication validate accepted semantics and their execution, not a school-semantic oracle. Other mechanical failures may still occur.

evidence.claim: Field-required check only runs when semantic_part_carries_field(part) is true.
Readiness evaluates existing field parts, carriers, body members, and compiled plan.
Publication provenance iterates submitted/resolved slots and field IDs.
General publication requirement is at least one registry-bound fill interface, not all semantically needed vocabulary fields.
Shape validation requires field_id for executable roles but does not infer fill_slot from reason.

not_inferred: Why the model is currently retrying or why any particular revision fails.
Whether current live candidate still matches this frozen initial signature.
Whether a repaired candidate would pass materialization or publication.
Whether source text cleanup/fixed roles are semantically acceptable.
